finding.summary: Reviewer did not produce a valid verdict: review: every credential in the pool (2) was retired — nothing left to fail over to

verdict.reason: The quoted text ("...every credential in the pool (2) was retired — nothing left to fail over to") is not prose the repo contains anywhere in docs/tasks, READMEs, changelogs, or user-facing documentation — it does not exist in docs/ at all. It is a runtime error-message template from the review harness itself (scripts/agent/ask.mjs:596, .trusted/scripts/agent/ask.mjs:632, tested at .trusted/scripts/agent/ask.test.mjs:302), wrapped by review-panel.mjs ("Reviewer did not produce a valid verdict: ${err.message}", review-panel.mjs:2614/:1693) when a lens's own session crashes (here, credential-pool exhaustion). The pipeline explicitly classifies this exact pattern as an infrastructure signal rather than a review finding (rounds.mjs:561-565, the INFRA_SUMMARY regex and its comment), and pages it separately via review-round-guard.mjs:183/188 rather than treating it as content for a docs/prose review. There is no file location given because there is no such file — the 'finding' is a garbled restatement of the reviewing agent's own infra failure, not planted or stale prose in this repository's docs lane.
